description: Optional boot clearance: screen your system prompt and tool descriptions once at start-up for injection, tool poisoning and embedded secrets. Returns a clearance_id (a verifiable SHA-256 receipt) that this server then sends with your later Shield calls (0.005 USDC per call). Heuristic screening — will miss attacks.
